decision.explanation: Document D1S3 explicitly states that 'It was designed by architect Leila Ross Wilburn,' referring directly to the Kidd House in Lavonia, Georgia. This is the only source that unambiguously identifies the architect of the Kidd House in Lavonia. While Document D4S8 and D5S1 mention Willis Irwin as an architect, they refer to the McCurry-Kidd House in Hartwell, Georgia — a distinct property — and not the Kidd House in Lavonia. Therefore, only 'Leila Ross Wilburn' is retained as the valid answer for the architect of the Kidd House in Lavonia.
